summary: Dependable Human Resources Generalist with over fourteen years of experience in fast‑paced environments. Strong team player with excellent people skills, conflict resolution, and a proven track record in benefits, compensation, employee relations, recruiting, payroll, and new hire/termination processing.

experience.title: HR Generalist
responsibilities: Implemented biometric clock and attendance policy for hourly employees.
Advised managers on discipline action policy and created a new vacation calendar.
Coordinated employee engagement activities and safety procedures.
Managed employee relations investigations, performance reviews, and merit increases.
Assisted benefits management, open enrollment training, and new hire orientations.
Processed payroll via ADP, reviewed time cards, and ran reports.
Handled employee actions (hires, terminations, status changes) using PeopleSoft.
Managed leaves of absence, FMLA, and workers’ compensation.
Conducted exit interviews and facilitated year‑end talent reviews.

experience.title: HR Representative
responsibilities: Answered employee questions on benefits and HR policies.
Investigated and resolved employee inquiries and complaints.
Processed new hires, transfers, leaves of absence, and terminations.
Produced monthly headcount reports and processed merit increases and bonuses.

experience.title: Human Resources Assistant / Payroll Coordinator
responsibilities: Provided administrative support to HR Director, Generalist, and staffing team.
Delivered new hire orientation on benefits and payroll procedures.
Processed payroll functions including new hires, terminations, and leaves of absence.

experience.title: HR Generalist
responsibilities: Consulted and coached managers on employee relations and conflict resolution.
Managed visa and relocation processes for employees.
Assisted with talent planning, performance reviews, and compensation.
Handled employee inquiries, benefits, and policy interpretation.
Processed new hires, transfers, leaves of absence, and terminations.
Produced headcount reports and processed year‑end bonuses and salary actions.
